d: Caroline is furious at what she sees as a betrayal of Du Plessis when Danny agrees to work with his old rival Ed Lynch.
The family is still estranged after Caroline moves back to Clearwater House, but Rosie is determined to reunite everyone.
Danny is in prison, accused of murdering Peeters, but Du Plessis is determined to prove his friends innocence.
While left in charge of running the Endangered Species Project, Ed meets a beautiful stranger.
As Danny and Ed prep for a review of the Endangered Species Project, a mystery woman arrives claiming to be Eds wife.
The family is in dire financial straits and needs a solution fast. Meanwhile, Danny receives devastating news.
Preparing to return to the UK, Danny jumps at the chance for a final adventure when the National Park requests help.
Alice has returned, but the stress of combining work with caring for baby Bobby causes tension between her and Danny.
